handlers.body:
function nh takes nothing returns boolean
local unit s=GetEventDamageSource()
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local integer Vh
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A03Q')>0)then
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A0F1')>0)then
call oh(s,.5*GetEventDamage(),GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),IsUnitType(s,UNIT_TYPE_ATTACKS_GROUND),IsUnitType(s,UNIT_TYPE_ATTACKS_FLYING))
endif
set Vh=GetUnitTypeId(s)
if(Vh=='u00D')then
call PG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='h05L')then
call qG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='h061')then
call QG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='n02A')then
call sG(u)
elseif(Vh=='n02B')then
call UnitRemoveAbility(s,'A0C8')
elseif(Vh=='e006')then
call TG(u)
elseif(Vh=='e009')then
call uG(u)
elseif(Vh=='e00C')then
call wG(s,u)
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A0DW')>0)then
call DisableTrigger(ln)
call UnitDamageTarget(s,u,50.*GetUnitLevel(s)*GetWidgetLife(s)/ GetUnitState(s,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE),true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_SIEGE,DAMAGE_TYPE_DEMOLITION,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
call EnableTrigger(ln)
elseif(Vh=='h02Y')then
call YG(s)
endif
endif
if(GetWidgetLife(u)>.405 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C5')>0)then
set Vh=GetUnitTypeId(u)
if(Vh=='n029')then
call SG(u)
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C4')>0 and GetWidgetLife(u)<255.)then
call Dg(u)
else
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'Asla')
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0C6')
endif
elseif(Vh=='n02B')then
call tG(u)
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C4')>0 and GetWidgetLife(u)<255.)then
call dg(u)
else
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'Asla')
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0C7')
endif
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DX')>0)then
call WG(s,u)
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EZ')>0)then
call eh(u)
elseif(Vh=='o00E')then
call vh(u,GetEventDamage())
endif
endif
if(Vi)then
call wC(u)
endif
set u=null
set s=null
return false
endfunction

handlers.name: ag
handlers.body:
function ag takes nothing returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)
local integer SA=2*ea[GetPlayerId(p)]
local integer i=0
local integer j=0
local unit u
loop
set u=sA(SA+j)
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'Awha')
call SetUnitOwner(u,p,false)
call UnitAddType(u,UNIT_TYPE_SAPPER)
call cB(u)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',42.)
set j=j+1
if(j>1)then
set j=0
endif
set i=i+1
call TriggerSleepAction(.3)
exitwhen i>=6
endloop
set u=null
endfunction

	set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)

	set bj_groupRandomConsidered=0

handlers.name: Xd
handlers.body:
function Xd takes unit u returns boolean
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A')>0)then
		call Vd(u)
		return true
	elseif(GetUnitTypeId(u)=='n01T')then
		if(GetRandomInt(0,99)<60)then
			call Ed(u)
			return true
		else
			return false
		endif
	endif
	return GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A070')>0
endfunction

handlers.name: Vd
handlers.body:
function Vd takes unit u returns nothing
	local integer i=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A')
	local integer j=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09L')
	if(i==2)then
		if(IsUnitAliveBJ(u) and j==2)then
			call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A',1)
			if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10B') <= 0 then
				call UnitAddAbility(u,'A10B')
			endif
			call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE))
		endif
	else
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A09L')
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A10A')
	endif
	call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\AIvi\\AIviTarget.mdl",u,"origin"))
endfunction

handlers.name: yF
handlers.body:
function yF takes nothing returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(kv)
local integer i=0
local real x=GetUnitX(kv)
local real y=GetUnitY(kv)
local destructable array YF
local real an
local real r
local unit u
local real x2
local real y2
call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,144.,Ha)
loop
set u=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
exitwhen u==null
call GroupRemoveUnit(Nv,u)
if(u!=kv)then
set r=GetRandomReal(160.,218.)
set an=(GetRandomReal(135.,234.)+180.*ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))])*bj_DEGTORAD
set x2=x+r*Cos(an)
set y2=y+r*Sin(an)
call SetUnitX(u,x2)
call SetUnitY(u,y2)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MassTeleport\\MassTeleportCaster.mdl",x2,y2))
endif
endloop
set u=kv
loop
set an=72.*I2R(i)
set YF[i]=CreateDestructable('YTct',x+120.*Cos(an*bj_DEGTORAD),y+120.*Sin(an*bj_DEGTORAD),an,1.,0)
set i=i+1
exitwhen i>=5
endloop
call TriggerSleepAction(3.)
if(GetWidgetLife(u)>.405)then
set i=0
loop
if(GetWidgetLife(YF[i])>.405)then
call KillDestructable(YF[i])
set an=72.*I2R(i)
set x2=x+112.*Cos(an*bj_DEGTORAD)
set y2=y+112.*Sin(an*bj_DEGTORAD)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(CreateUnit(p,'e00D',x2,y2,an),'B021',20.)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\NightElf\\EntBirthTarget\\EntBirthTarget.mdl",x2,y2))
endif
set i=i+1
exitwhen i>=5
endloop
call cB(u)
else
set i=0
loop
call KillDestructable(YF[i])
set i=i+1
exitwhen i>=5
endloop
endif
call TriggerSleepAction(3.)
set i=0
loop
call RemoveDestructable(YF[i])
set YF[i]=null
set i=i+1
exitwhen i>=5
endloop
set u=null
endfunction
